name: Café Sabor (Logan & Garden City, UT) Sizzling Chicken & Steak Fajitas (Flour Tortillas)
brandOrRestaurant: Café Sabor (Logan & Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Marinated grilled chicken breast and flank steak provide clean, unbreaded protein. Roll the tender meats inside warm flour tortillas with Spanish rice. Leave aside bell peppers and onions.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chicken or Steak Fajitas with flour tortillas and Spanish rice; eat the tender meats and leave the sautéed peppers/onions.
watchOuts: Avoid eating the sautéed onions and peppers if prone to gas or bloating
